Found under Settings, Sync and accounts, Receive an item.

<a id="page-receive"></a>

## About this page

Takes one item from another device through two codes, with nothing sent over a network.

#### How it works

This page shows a code. On the other device, open the item, choose **Send to a device**, and scan or paste this code.

That device then shows an answer. Paste it here and choose **Open it**. The item is added to this vault and opens.

The code holds a key made for this one handover, and only that key opens the answer, so a photo of either code is no use to anyone else. It works once and stops in two minutes.

#### When to use it

To pass one login to another device, yours or someone else's, without pairing them or sharing a vault.

#### Limits

What arrives is a copy without its history, attachments, folder, tags or links, under a new id.

#### On Android

This page shows a code. On the other device, open the item, choose **Send to a device**, and scan this.

That device then shows an answer. Choose **Scan its answer** and scan it. The item is added to this vault and opens.

The code holds a key made for this one handover, and only that key opens the answer, so a photo of either code is no use to anyone else. It works once and stops in two minutes.

See also [Sync and accounts](/guide/settings/sync/), [Nested and shared vaults](/guide/settings/vaults/).
